b13.geledah: Geledah kamar Abang, lalu ambil keputusan di depan pintunya
b13.keputusan: Ambil keputusan di depan kamar Abang

lemari.1: Lemari Abang kubuka pelan. Bau tanah basah langsung keluar.
lemari.2: Sepatu kerja di pojok bawah masih basah. Solnya berlumpur.
lemari.3: Dua hari lalu Abang bilang ia kerja sampai malam. Kupercaya.

sepatu.1: Tanah di sol hitam pekat. Bukan tanah kebun.
sepatu.2: Ini tanah ladang di tepi hutan. Ladang yang pernah terbakar.

tangan.1: Tangan Abang terbalut kain di rak atas. Ada bekas merah di pergelangan.
tangan.2: Ia bilang jatuh dari motor. Kainnya sudah diganti dua kali minggu ini.

robek.1: Baju lengan panjang robek di bahu. Tiga jahitan lepas.
robek.2: Abang bilang kena ranting. Tapi robekannya lurus dan bersih.

akhiri.1: Kututup lemari itu. Aku lanjut ke meja.

jaket.1: Jaket Abang tergantung di kursi miring. Bau tanah basah menempel.
jaket.2: Ada benjolan di saku dalam. Bukan dompet, bukan kunci.
jaket.3: Kartu nama. Satu lembar, ujungnya sobek sedikit.
jaket.4: Nama pemilik lahan di sisi hutan. Di belakangnya tertulis nomor plat mobil hitam.

catatan.1: Buku catatan kecil di meja samping kasur. Tulisan Abang.
catatan.2: Tiga malam terakhir ia pulang lewat tengah malam. Selalu satu alasan.
catatan.3: Aku tulis jamnya. Nanti kucocokkan dengan kalender di dinding.

rudi.1: Raka? Wo, siang begini ada apa?
rudi.2: Aku mau tanya soal Abang. Kalian kerja bertiga kan?
rudi.c2: Tekan. Bilang aku tahu dia sering keluar malam.

santai.1: Baik, bro. Cuma panas terus, jadi pada nongkrong di pondok.
santai.2: Aku buka pelan-pelan. Rudi masih santai.

tekan.1: ...apaan sih, bro. Gua kerja, pulang, tidur. Gitu aja.

halus.1: Jam sembilan bro, kadang lewat. Proyek kan jauh.
halus.2: Jam sembilan. Tapi Abang selalu pulang lewat tengah malam.

curiga.1: Aku bilang ada yang salah dengan malam-malam itu.
curiga.3: Tidak. Aku cuma cerita. Tapi tolong jangan bilang siapa-siapa.

konf_kurang.1: Tanganku sudah di kenop pintu kamar Abang.
konf_kurang.2: Aku belum punya cukup bukti. Kalau salah, ia akan menutup diri selamanya.

yes.1: Aku ketuk pintu itu. Kata-kata keluar sebelum sempat kupertimbangkan.
yes.2: Abang membuka. Wajahnya kaku. Aku tahu ini terlalu cepat.

yes.1: Aku taruh struk robek itu di meja. Lalu kutunjuk tanggal di kalender.
yes.3: Suaranya pecah di tengah. Ia menyangkal, tapi tubuhnya goyah. Aku jadi lebih sedikit percaya padanya.

tidak.2: Aku turun ke bawah dan mengumpulkan lagi.

keluar.1: Struk, kalender, kartu nama. Semua sudah masuk jurnal.
keluar.2: Siang ini terasa lebih berat dari kemarin. Aku keluar kamar.

p2.title: Struk Robek
p2.desc: Rakit kembali struk itu. Baca jumlah dan tanggalnya.
p2.h2: Struk ini menyimpan jumlah utang dan satu tanggal.

p3.title: Kalender Dinding
p3.desc: Tarik tiga berita ke tanggal yang ditandai pensil.
p3.h2: Cocokkan dengan catatan jam pulang Abang.

ev1.d: Warga memadamkan sendiri. Tidak ada yang melapor.

ev2.d: Terlihat sore hari. Keesokan harinya hilang.

ev3.d: Api mulai sebelum subuh. Penyebabnya tidak jelas.

b13.geledah: Search Bang's room, then make a decision at his door
b13.kalender: Check the calendar on the wall
b13.keputusan: Make a decision at Bang's door

lemari.1: I open Bang's wardrobe slowly. The smell of wet soil comes straight out.
lemari.2: His work boots in the bottom corner are still wet. The soles are muddy.
lemari.3: Two days ago Bang said he worked until late. I believed him.
lemari.c1: Check the soles of those boots.
lemari.c2: The bandage on the top shelf.
lemari.c3: The torn shirt under the pile.
lemari.c4: Leave it. I will look elsewhere.

sepatu.1: The soil on the sole is pitch black. Not garden soil.
sepatu.2: This is field soil from the forest edge. The field that once burned.

tangan.1: Bang's hand is wrapped in cloth on the top shelf. There is a red mark on his wrist.
tangan.2: He said he fell off his motorbike. The cloth has been changed twice this week.

robek.1: A long sleeved shirt is torn at the shoulder. Three seams came loose.
robek.2: Bang said a branch caught it. But the tear is straight and clean.

akhiri.1: I close the wardrobe. I move on to the desk.

jaket.1: Bang's jacket hangs on a crooked chair. The smell of wet soil clings to it.
jaket.2: There is a lump in the inner pocket. Not a wallet, not keys.
jaket.3: A business card. One sheet, one corner slightly torn.
jaket.4: The name of the landowner by the forest. On the back, a black car's plate number.

catatan.1: A small notebook on the table by the bed. Bang's handwriting.
catatan.2: For three nights he came home after midnight. Always the same excuse.
catatan.3: I write down the hours. Later I will match them with the calendar on the wall.

rudi.1: Raka? Hey, what is up this time of day?
rudi.2: I want to ask about Bang. You three work together, right?
rudi.c1: Keep it light. Ask how he is doing.
rudi.c2: Press him. Say I know he goes out at night.
rudi.c3: Dig gently. Ask about his hours.

santai.1: All good, bro. Just hot all the time, so everyone hangs out at the shed.
santai.2: I ease into it. Rudi is still relaxed.

tekan.1: ...what is this, bro. I work, I go home, I sleep. That is it.
tekan.2: His voice goes up. Something is being covered.

halus.1: Nine o'clock, bro, sometimes later. The site is far.
halus.2: Nine o'clock. But Bang always comes home after midnight.

curiga.1: I say there is something wrong about those nights.
curiga.3: I do not. I am just talking. But please tell no one.

konf_kurang.1: My hand is already on the knob of Bang's door.
konf_kurang.2: I do not have enough evidence yet. If I am wrong, he will close himself off forever.

yes.1: I knock on the door. The words come out before I can think them through.
yes.2: Bang opens. His face is stiff. I know this is too soon.

tidak.1: I pull my hand off the knob.
tidak.2: Not yet. Gather the evidence first.

yes.1: I put the torn receipt on the table. Then I point at the dates on the calendar.
yes.3: His voice breaks in the middle. He denies it, but his body sways. I end up believing him a little less.

tidak.1: I call it off. The time is not right.
tidak.2: I go back down and gather more.

keluar.1: Receipt, calendar, business card. All of it is in the journal.
keluar.2: This afternoon feels heavier than yesterday. I leave the room.

p2.title: Torn Receipt
p2.desc: Put the receipt back together. Read the total and the date.
p2.h1: Start with the pieces from the edge.
p2.h2: This receipt holds a debt total and one date.

p3.title: Wall Calendar
p3.desc: Drag the three news items to the dates marked in pencil.
p3.h1: The dates are marked in pencil, not ink.
p3.h2: Match them with your notes on Bang's hours.

ev1.t: Brush fire near the prayer hall
ev1.d: Villagers put it out themselves. No one reported it.

ev2.d: Seen in the evening. Gone the next day.

ev3.t: Field by the forest scorched in parts
ev3.d: The fire started before dawn. The cause is unclear.
